sourceAudit.note: The audit is pinned to an older main commit. Finding status below was rechecked against this work branch by source inspection; this is not a fresh CI, device, provider, or release qualification.

statusDefinitions.implemented: The code path is present in this branch. It does not imply a passing test, native build, device exercise, or public release.
statusDefinitions.partial: The core path is present, while a material capability, performance measurement, integration, or qualification remains open.
statusDefinitions.gated: The capability intentionally stays disabled or experimental until its stated external or platform evidence exists.

localization.qualityStatus: Structural locale coverage is present; native-speaker fluency review is not established by key counts or generated-file checks.

productBoundaries.open: The bounded mixed-media deck, profile-local Saved picks/history, exact filters, mood/familiarity filtering, explicit local taste controls, per-pick hide/restore/reset, capped isolated OPDS samples, exact-public-ID adaptation matching, two-to-three-item comparison, private co-present shortlist voting, and opt-in encrypted Saved-pick sync are implemented. Optional AI reranking uses opaque IDs and bounded metadata with deterministic fallback. Open Library adds browse-only catalog records; when the existing OverDrive gate is enabled, connected borrower catalogs can add local-only candidates that are revalidated by exact library and book IDs before opening. OverDrive remains disabled by default and availability is checked only in its existing detail flow. Feature acceptance, provider exercises, native builds and physical-device qualification have not run for this slice. No research-cohort feature is in scope.
The current comic reading path exists. The separate conflicted PR #25 work must be reconciled against the current base before integration; Chromium and native reader qualification remain separate.
Android GameStream and Steam paths remain experimental. Real host sessions, physical controller/TV navigation, lifecycle, and device qualification are required before broadening release claims.
Keep the workspace branch isolated. Per-session native ownership, concurrent decoder limits, composition, accessibility, and device acceptance are not release-qualified.

The Linux projectM host and same-player PCM extension are implemented in source and require patched native dependencies that are not in the current binary lock. The library includes a bundled/pinned CC0 fixture, local preset/pack import, per-profile favorites/playlists and playback controls. Native artifacts, full MilkRust rendering, shader/.milk2 fidelity, other platform hosts, a broader cleared download library, signed catalog updates, web storage and device qualification remain open.
Keep experiments identified as experimental and default-off where configured. Reference-output, signaling, seek/sync, and platform evidence are still required.
Keep OverDrive disabled until provider approval, deployed gateway controls, assigned sandbox credentials, and live fulfillment qualification are available.
Workflows must stay on compatible private ephemeral JIT runners with no hosted fallback. This PR does not dispatch a workflow or establish live pool capacity.

findings.title: Profile source loading and adapter ownership
findings.qualification: Profile data is staged and published as one owner-scoped snapshot; stale loads and adapter callbacks are generation-guarded. Adversarial A→B→A completion-order and credential-refresh acceptance has not been run on this branch.

findings.title: Exact-commit required-job release gate
findings.qualification: The release workflow checks the newest manually dispatched main CI run for the exact SHA and requires every named job, including each matrix expansion, to complete successfully. The changed workflow has not been dispatched on private JIT; negative-gate and successful-candidate evidence remain pending.

findings.title: Verified Apple purchase entitlement
findings.qualification: A StoreKit purchase event cannot grant a new entitlement until verified transaction history confirms ownership; empty history is treated as unknown, and revocation is handled separately. StoreKit configuration and sandbox replay, restore, invalid, refund, and offline cases remain unqualified.

findings.title: Profile-bound, bounded settings backup and restore
findings.qualification: The initiating profile identity and mutation generation are captured before storage awaits; restore is streamed with a 4 MiB cap and import checks ownership through guarded writes and rollback. Switch-during-download, malformed payload, and mid-write failure scenarios have not been run on this branch.

findings.title: Source edit option preservation
findings.qualification: Edits retain unrecognized provider options and carry the applicable NFS, OAuth drive, and sync identity fields. Provider-by-provider edit/reconnect round-trip acceptance remains pending.

findings.title: Independent encrypted and provider sync targets
findings.qualification: Cloud and provider targets retain independent acknowledgments, failure reporting, and retry state. Two-device conflict convergence against live provider accounts remains unqualified.

findings.title: Atomic bounded discovery Undo history
findings.qualification: History appends then keeps the newest 500 actions within an atomic database read-modify-write. Boundary and concurrent-device cases have not been run on this branch.

findings.title: Complete-scan index deletion reconciliation
findings.qualification: A generation mark is reconciled only when a scan completes; failed and cancelled partial scans do not delete unvisited rows. Deleted-source-entry and interrupted-scan durability acceptance remains pending.

findings.title: Bounded source index and page retrieval
findings.qualification: UI retrieval is SQL-paged and local directory snapshots are bounded in memory and on disk. Oversized directories can be re-enumerated; target-device latency, memory, and I/O budgets have not been measured.

findings.title: Reusable NFS RPC sessions and bounded read-ahead
findings.qualification: Adapters reuse a bounded RPC session pool and permit at most four read-ahead lanes. NAS interoperability, cancellation, and repeated throughput measurements remain unqualified.

findings.title: Durable bounded publication download jobs
findings.qualification: The app persists jobs, applies per-profile quota and free-space bounds, recovers interrupted transfers, and limits native background transfer to explicit safe subsets. Crash/resume, low-space, and platform lifecycle acceptance remains open.

findings.title: Cross-device shared book identity
findings.qualification: Explicit shared-library and shared-item IDs can map provider entries and uniquely compatible editions. Copied local books are not automatically joined by title or content digest; households must establish matching IDs on participating devices.

findings.title: Sync failure isolation, capacity, and recovery
findings.qualification: Per-target retry, bounded state, causal annotation tombstones, compaction, and encrypted recovery exist. Multi-device retirement and stale offline-device rejoin behavior still need explicit convergence evidence.

findings.title: Reader browser and native platform qualification
findings.qualification: The main Unit Tests job installs Playwright Chromium and runs the reader browser suite; this branch has not run that job. Android WebView, Apple WebKit, Windows WebView2, Linux external-browser lifecycle, and physical reader acceptance remain separate.

findings.title: Capability, release, and documentation truth
findings.qualification: A source-linked status ledger and repository guard now cover the audit findings, 37 locale files, privacy disclosure, and the honest releases-page link. Version 2.24.1 remains a draft; public assets and native-speaker review are not established.

findings.title: Automatic metadata lookup privacy expectations
findings.qualification: Metadata lookup defaults off. The privacy notice identifies the title/year/episode/NFO identifier sent to Trakt when opted in and states that file bytes, full paths, and source credentials are excluded. Request-capture acceptance was not run on this branch.

findings.title: MilkDrop visualizer and preset pack workflow
findings.qualification: Source implements the bounded verified pack workflow, offline bundled starter, local imports, profile controls, and Linux classic .milk playback through pinned projectM/PCM patches. Default artifacts still lack those APIs; playback is capability-gated. .milk2 is stored but unavailable, user archives are not author-authenticated, and unresolved community sources remain link-only. No tests, CI, native builds, rendering captures or device qualification ran. Source patch composition does not count as runtime evidence.
